scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shell,users,dashboard -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @mfe/shell" "npm run dev -w @mfe/users" "npm run dev -w @mfe/dashboard"
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n shell,users,dashboard -c blue,green,magenta "npm run preview -w @mfe/shell" "npm run preview -w @mfe/users" "npm run preview -w @mfe/dashboard"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run preview
